rationale: Clean EOS template: governance config + docs only, no product code yet. Set "language" to the BCP-47 tag you want agents to answer in (e.g. "zh-CN"); remove it to mirror whatever language you write in. Change projectType to "application" (or "library"), list your stacks and fill in commands.test as soon as real code lands — see docs/eos/stack-presets.md. Building an LLM/agent product? Add "agentic" to productParadigms so the G-EVAL gate turns on. "workflowProfile" selects the gate policy in .eos/workflow.json; "complianceProfile": "regulated" turns the compliance boundary on early (docs/compliance-profile.json stays authoritative).
